// name: Scoped @applyy (two y's) per the naming standard; the folder still reads applyyy pending Teja's rename.
name: @applyy/resume-template
// version: Workspace-internal only; nothing is ever published to a registry.
// private: This package renders a real resume containing personal data — an accidental `pnpm publish` must be impossible.
// type: ESM only. Deno Edge Functions cannot consume CommonJS and the Node worker is ESM.
// exports: Source-only export map, pointing at .ts. Proven by the section-20-step-0 spike: Node v24 strips types, Deno reads .ts natively, Vite transpiles — so a build step would only create a second, stale copy of the one function the approval guarantee depends on.
// types: Redundant with exports for modern resolvers; kept for editors that still read this field.
// files: Only src ships if this is ever packed.
// scripts.typecheck: tsc is a checker only — noEmit is inherited from tsconfig.base.json.
// scripts.test: node --test runs .ts directly via native type stripping, so the test suite needs no runner dependency and no build.
// dependencies: shared-types carries the bullet-ID and skill-ID shapes that are the anti-fabrication defense; it is imported, never re-declared.
// devDependencies: typescript for standalone type-checking; @types/node ONLY because the tests use node:test and node:crypto. src/ uses no Node API, because the renderer must stay importable by Deno and the browser too.
